sources.title: peculiar-ragdoll/Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-MLX-oQ4e-MTP · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Other setups have seen real gains on this exact model family — the sibling KaedeTai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-BigBang-MTP-mlx-4bit reports ~1.16× on an M5 Max, and our GGUF-MTP build gains on llama.cpp (whose C++ batched-MoE verify is more efficient). We ship this so users whose hardware benefits can use it.
